role: Runtime B — EXL3 path on NVIDIA Ampere
label: SGLang 0.5.20 + sglang_exl3
commit_verification: git ls-remote sgl-project/sglang: refs/tags/v0.5.20 dereferences to 94602c9c2b7cbdb8efd5c52802dac6a1c180089e, which also equals refs/heads/release/v0.5.20; the 7-character pin '94602c9' matches
failure_class: driver / CUDA-major incompatibility in the supplied environment (NOT a model or EXL3 support finding)

plugin_inspection.note: With trellis_exl3_kernels absent, SGLANG_EXL3_KERNEL=auto falls back to ExLlamaV3's own bit-faithful kernels (linear.py: 'if _MARLIN in ("auto","marlin") and marlin.probe().available'), so a Marlin build is not strictly required to run the plugin. This was verified in source but never reached at runtime because the core runtime is not installable.
plugin_inspection.upstream_reference_image: ghcr.io/0xsero/sglang-exl3:v0.7.0-ampere@sha256:c8922bd7256caf1b273af7ac49221e652be9e6072c1cdec4b959f506fd415d79 (not usable: the VM is an unprivileged container without Docker-in-Docker)

blocker.summary: sglang==0.5.20 hard-pins torch==2.13.0, which exists only as a CUDA 13.0 build; this VM's driver (550.144.03) supports CUDA 12.4 maximum.
blocker.torch_2_13_0_cuda_profile: CUDA 13.0: cuda-toolkit[cublas,cudart,...]==13.0.3, nvidia-cudnn-cu13==9.20.0.48, nvidia-nccl-cu13==2.29.7, nvidia-nvshmem-cu13==3.4.5, cuda-bindings>=13.0.3
blocker.no_cuda12_path: PyTorch index cu126 / cu128 / cu129 newest torch is 2.9.1; torch 2.13.0 is published only for CUDA 13, so the torch==2.13.0 pin cannot be satisfied with a CUDA 12 build.

runtime_probe.method: installed cuda-toolkit[cudart]==13.0.3 in a scratch env and loaded the CUDA 13 runtime directly
runtime_probe.cudaGetErrorString: CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime version

blocker.driver_upgrade_note: Unprivileged container; the NVIDIA kernel driver is host-managed and cannot be changed from inside.

not_attempted_by_design: porting MiniCPM model architecture into SGLang
substituting another model or another quantization format
re_run_requirement: Re-attempt on a host whose driver supports CUDA 13 (r580+). The MiniCPM5 compatibility gate (architecture, EXL3 tensor layout, dense linears, embeddings, lm_head) must still be passed empirically; nothing in this campaign proves or disproves it.
